sentences.text:
Shri Surendra Singh - Senior Advocate with Shri Shivam
 Advocate for petitioner.
Shri Y.D.Yadav - Govt. Advocate for respondent-State.

Petitioner has filed this petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C for quashing of complaint registered
under Section 7(1) sub section 16(1)(A)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
2.  Learned Sr. Counsel appearing for petitioner submitted that petitioner is arrayed in the complaint case as a nominee of Company but Company has not been made party.

In these circumstances,
complaint filed by State is not maintainable.
Learned Sr. Counsel placed reliance on the order passed by Indore Bench of this Court on 04.09.2023 in M.Cr.C.no.5958/2021 3.
Issue notice to respondent No.2 on payment of PF within seven days.
Notice be made returnable within four weeks.
4. Learned Sr. Counsel makes a prayer for grant of interim relief and to stay proceedings in Criminal Case No.8444/2011, for which, an application - I.A.No.27864/2023 is filed.

5. Heard learned Sr. Counsel for petitioner.
6.
For grounds taken in stay application and the fact that Company is not impleaded as party by Food Inspector and petitioner is only a nominee of Company, therefore, I.A.No.27864/2023 is allowed.
It is ordered that till next date of hearing, further proceedings in Criminal Case No.8444/2011 shall remain stayed till next date of hearing.

4. List this matter after four weeks.
Certified copy as per rules.
(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE nd Saud Mohammad Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 1 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137223501/
